title: MiniDSH 2.0: One Runtime, Every Surface

approvals.note: In plan mode the user was asked "Which treatment should the MiniDSH launch film be built on?" with three candidates and answered "A: One session, three surfaces (Recommended)"; in the same round they chose WSL for the terminal and web with the desktop on Windows, the official v2.0.0 installer, and the font-size reading of the 36 px text bar, then approved the plan (treatment A, refined as A-prime by a creative review the same day).

Shown the 1080p60 review cut (84.5 s, out/minidsh-launch/post/review/minidsh-launch.mp4) with the side-by-side against the DSH reference, what was and was not verified (nobody had listened to the score), and the known weak spots, and asked for the review approval or notes, the user answered: "Approved, use "Node inside." and render the final". The desktop title became "Its own window. Node inside." as they chose.

Shown the final (out/minidsh-launch/post/final/minidsh-launch.mp4, frame for frame the approved review cut except the new desktop title, aiv qa passed on the delivery and the archive master) and the publish kit, the user answered: "OK approved." and asked for stills from the film to make the thumbnail with ChatGPT.

next: Upload: the creator makes the thumbnail (stills in out/minidsh-launch/publish-candidates/), uploads the final with the publish kit; then aiv release, the release commit and tag, the push when asked.
